note: BLM land in the Arkansas Headwaters Recreation Area, operated by Colorado Parks & Wildlife, on the south bank of the Arkansas River just east of Salida on US-50 near mile marker 224 (highway noise). Boat ramp, river access and a reservable group picnic area. --Claude

Waterfront (stored riverfront) kept: cpwshop tags 9 drive-in sites 'Proximity to Water: Riverfront' (1602, 1603, 1604, 1606, 1607, 1609, 1611, 1614, 1615) plus hike-ins 1626-1629 and 1633. On NAIP the Arkansas (~50-60 m wide) runs along the loop's north-east side; 1606, 1607, 1609 and 1611 sit ~15-25 m from the bank behind a broken fringe of cottonwood and juniper with open ground between the trees, and 1602-1604 are near the boat ramp at the east end. Not a fully open apron, so a strict reading could put it at riverview; CPW's per-site tag is the operator's own call.
Phone 719-539-7289 confirmed (AHRA park office, CPW page).
Pin 38.50737,-105.96062 is at the campground entrance off US-50, ~60-120 m from the nearest pads; the cpwshop site centroid is ~38.5081,-105.9608 (~80 m). OK.
